account_accepted_before_active.name: account_accepted_before_active
account_accepted_before_active.value: "account"."status" NOT IN ('active', 'paused') OR "account"."terms_accepted_at" IS NOT NULL

account_limit_something_set.name: account_limit_something_set
account_limit_something_set.value: "account_limit"."value" IS NOT NULL OR "account_limit"."period_type" IS NOT NULL

account_limit_custom_days.name: account_limit_custom_days
account_limit_custom_days.value: ("account_limit"."period_type" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'custom_days') = ("account_limit"."period_days" IS NOT NULL) AND ("account_limit"."period_days" IS NULL OR "account_limit"."period_days" > 0)

account_limit_monthly_calendar.name: account_limit_monthly_calendar
account_limit_monthly_calendar.value: ("account_limit"."period_type" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'monthly') = ("account_limit"."calendar" IS NOT NULL)

dispute_resolution.name: dispute_resolution
dispute_resolution.value: "dispute"."status" = 'open' OR "dispute"."resolution_entry_id" IS NOT NULL OR "dispute"."resolution_note" IS NOT NULL

entry_origin_fields.name: entry_origin_fields
entry_origin_fields.value:
("entry"."origin" = 'device' AND "entry"."device_id" IS NOT NULL AND "entry"."device_seq" IS NOT NULL AND "entry"."device_sig" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("entry"."origin" = 'server' AND "entry"."device_id" IS NULL AND "entry"."device_seq" IS NULL AND "entry"."device_sig" IS NULL AND "entry"."request_id" IS NOT NULL)

entry_representative_iff.name: entry_representative_iff
entry_representative_iff.value: ("entry"."taken_by_type" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'representative') = ("entry"."representative_id" IS NOT NULL)

entry_correction_fields.name: entry_correction_fields
entry_correction_fields.value: "entry"."type" <> 'correction' OR ("entry"."ref_entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "entry"."reason" IS NOT NULL)

notification_recipient.name: notification_recipient
notification_recipient.value: "notification"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "notification"."phone" IS NOT NULL

representative_custom_days.name: representative_custom_days
representative_custom_days.value: ("representative"."limit_period_type" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'custom_days') = ("representative"."limit_period_days" IS NOT NULL) AND ("representative"."limit_period_days" IS NULL OR "representative"."limit_period_days" > 0)

representative_monthly_calendar.name: representative_monthly_calendar
representative_monthly_calendar.value: ("representative"."limit_period_type" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'monthly') = ("representative"."limit_calendar" IS NOT NULL)
